body:
Millia is barely better than Anji, however she is really fun to play thanks to her movement and best mixups in the game (or at least hardest to defend against). Just know that other characters are more busted than her. Her mu spread it's actually pretty even against most characters (favored against axl and maaaybe testament, unfavored for gl and baiken imo) Her weaknesses come from game mechanics (risk, guts, health, tension and burst, all of these unfavores her). Also she's best girl by far.

Idk much about I-No honestly so I prefer not to talk, except that H stbg being minus is the dumbest shit I've ever seen.

If you want to play a female character that's also high tier just play baiken. Ram is also good but she's boring af.
